contents.name: §19.5 Water velocity field

contents.name: §19.6 Bending of wave crests

contents.name: §19.7 Group velocity
contents.reason: Group velocity concerns superposed wave packets; the assigned theorem treats one exact mode and makes no packet or energy-transport claim.
